declared.keyed_on: API property names - the value side of each SDK model's _names map, and the property key in the OpenAPI documents. Never the Python attribute name, which the generator renames (plan.md group 4 step 4).
declared.path_syntax: Same as observed.json: $ is the record root and [] is an array element, so the two artifacts diff mechanically.
declared.not_evidence: A field here is declared, not delivered. Verdicts in specs/paypal-fields.md are judged on observed.json alone (requirements.md D1). This column is context.

apimatic_context_plugin.role: Named the SDK distribution and version; holds no PayPal field names. See requirements.md section 1 and notes.md, 'Prerequisite 1'.

read_from: doc/models/*.md - Name, Type and Tags, including Read-only

source_grades.sdk_generated_contract: Machine-extracted from the APIMatic-generated SDK at a pinned tag. The contract the SDK would enforce.
source_grades.openapi_specification: Machine-extracted from PayPal's own published OpenAPI 3.0.3 document at a pinned commit. Authoritative and pinnable, but not the contract the tested SDK generates, and it may lag the deployed API. See notes.md, Group 4.
